name: knows-you
description: Builds a revisable model of you: evidence, confidence, alternative explanations, review dates. Plain Markdown, local-first, no service.

interface.shortDescription: 越用越懂你，但每条结论都可被推翻
interface.longDescription: Keeps a readable, local Markdown profile of you and records behavioral hypotheses only as falsifiable guesses: with evidence, confidence, an alternative explanation, and a review date.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about me?
Save what is durable from this task.
Review the profile and retire what no longer fits.
